name: Crocodile
otherStatistics: Initiative +0 (10). Proficiency Bonus +2. Senses Passive Perception 10. Languages none.
appearance: An olive-brown crocodile with raised back scutes, a long snout and a thick, tapering tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast’s 2024-rules Monster Manual, p. 352, as published on D&D Beyond. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775811-crocodile
sections.Traits: Hold Breath. It can hold its breath for 1 hour.
sections.Actions: Bite. Make a +4 melee attack within 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage. A Medium or smaller creature hit is Grappled (escape DC 12) and remains Restrained while Grappled.
sections.Using the grapple: The target can use an action to escape with a DC 12 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check. The grapple ends if the crocodile is Incapacitated, if the target moves outside the grapple’s range, or if the crocodile releases it. Release takes no action. The crocodile must end the grapple before using its jaws against a different creature. See the 2024 rules glossary. https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#Grappling

name: Deer
otherStatistics: Initiative +3 (13). Proficiency Bonus +2. Senses Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 14. Languages none.
appearance: A tawny stag with a pale throat and underside, slender legs, and wide branching antlers.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast’s 2024-rules Monster Manual, p. 352, as published on D&D Beyond. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5194966-deer
sections.Traits: Agile. Moving out of an enemy’s reach does not provoke an Opportunity Attack.
sections.Actions: Ram. Make a +2 melee attack within 5 ft. A hit deals 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

name: Dire Wolf
otherStatistics: Initiative +2 (12). Proficiency Bonus +2. Senses Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 15. Languages none.
appearance: A heavy-built gray wolf with a thick neck ruff, pointed ears, long legs and a bushy tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast’s 2024-rules Monster Manual, p. 352, as published on D&D Beyond. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775812-dire-wolf
sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. It has Advantage on an attack against a creature if at least one ally within 5 ft. of that creature does not have the Incapacitated condition.
sections.Actions: Bite. Make a +5 melee attack within 5 ft. A hit deals 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage and knocks a Large or smaller creature Prone.
